name: com.uni-clilabs/uni-cli
title: Uni-CLI MCP Gateway
description: One MCP URL for your Uni-CLI organization: org-assigned skills, plugins, workflows, and connections (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and MCP servers), exposed through search_capabilities and execute_capability.

install.claude-code: claude mcp add --transport http uni-cli https://api.uni-clilabs.com/mcp/agent
install.codex: codex mcp add uni-cli --url https://api.uni-clilabs.com/mcp/agent && codex mcp login uni-cli
install.gemini-cli: gemini mcp add --transport http uni-cli https://api.uni-clilabs.com/mcp/agent
install.opencode: opencode mcp add uni-cli --url https://api.uni-clilabs.com/mcp/agent && opencode mcp auth uni-cli
